text:
Maya R: Solaris sent INV-6129 for $14,950 dated 2026-03-28 but Coupa failed to auto-match. Vendor says PO=SOL-320. Can procurement route? cc @Drew (Finance)
Aisha - Procurement: SOL-320 isn't in our current PO namespace. @Solaris Billing can you attach the invoice PDF and show the original onboarding note that gave that PO?
Solaris Billing: Link: https://billing.solaris.example/inv/INV-6129. PO field shows SOL-320 (legacy). Onboarding note references contact Liam from Infra. We'll reissue if you need a new PO.
Drew (Finance): Two things we need: (1) GL & project code, (2) itemized breakdown. Also if this is legacy PO we need procurement to reopen or create canonical PO before final payment.
Liam (Infra): Project PRJ-910 (Indexing infra). GL 5430. Item lines: core infra $12,000; burst GPUs $2,000; VAT $950.
POBot: Legacy PO scan: SOL-320 -> MATCH: PO_LEG_SOL320 assigned 2024-08-19, status ARCHIVED, owner Aisha - Procurement. Recommend reopen as PO-2026-622 and link legacy ref.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll create PO-2026-622 and link the legacy PO. Solaris, please resend invoice with new PO. If vendor needs USD conversion note that in invoice.
Solaris Billing: We can reissue same-day with PO-2026-622. Question: burst GPUs line looks higher than our usage reports. Can Infra confirm hours?
Liam (Infra): Looks like vendor billed 50 burst hours but telemetry shows 32. I'll attach usage export to Coupa and follow up.
Drew (Finance): Given discrepancy, propose provisional release up to $11,500 pending corrected invoice and PO link. Hold remainder until usage reconciled. Samir, any objections?
Samir (CFO): Approve provisional up to $11.5k for operational continuity. Hold $3,450 pending usage reconciliation and corrected invoice with PO-2026-622. Finance annotate memo "provisional - pending legacy PO reconcile and usage verification".
Solaris Billing: Reissued invoice INV-6129-R with PO=PO-2026-622 and updated line items. Uploaded to portal.
POBot: PO-2026-622 created and linked to PO_LEG_SOL320. Status: OPEN.
Liam (Infra): Uploaded telemetry extract showing 32 burst hours. If Solaris cannot reconcile to 32, we'll open dispute for the 18-hour delta.
Drew (Finance): Received corrected invoice and telemetry. Queuing provisional payment per CFO for $11,500 and placing $3,450 on hold. Opening dispute ticket with vendor for the delta.
Aisha - Procurement: Documenting mapping in PRQ-2026-199 to prevent future legacy PO confusion.
Maya R: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until dispute resolved. :mag:
